title: Avatar Component

name.description: Unique name identifier for the avatar

src.description: Image URL. Falls back to initials when empty or failed to load

firstName.description: Explicit first name (organization user form). Takes priority over name

lastName.description: Explicit last name (organization user form). Takes priority over name

name.description: Full display name, e.g. '{{ row.record.name }}'. 'Andre Kovac' → AK, 'Kovac, Andre' → AK, single word → first two letters

email.description: Fallback when no name resolves: initials from the local part, digits dropped ('andre.kovac@…' → AK)

colorSeed.description: Stable seed for the deterministic color, e.g. '{{ row.record.contactId }}'. Use an id, not the display name, so renames don't change the color. Defaults to the resolved text

color.description: Pin a theme color instead of the colorSeed hash. Theme colors: primary, secondary, error, warning, info, success

skin.description: Fill style: light (default) is a tinted background with a colored letter, filled is a solid theme color. Values: filled, light, light-static

variant.description: Shape, default circular. Values: circular, rounded, square

onClick.description: Actions to execute on click; when present the avatar is clickable

permission.description: Permission(s) required to render the avatar: a permission string or an array of permission strings

description: Circular avatar with automatic two-letter initials. Sources are tried in priority order: src image, firstName + lastName, name, email, then a placeholder user icon.
